notes.title: The Lullaby of Life in the Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
Hello Ohmies!

The Steam Awards are on-going and we humbly hope you will consider nominating The Lullaby of Life for the “Best Soundtrack” award. 

From its inception, music has been at the core of The Lullaby of Life, depicting a vision of our world that spawns from harmonious sounds. The soundtrack is what brings that greater world to life across the stages of construction, destruction, and conservation. 

Working with Soundscape and composer Oscar Azcautli Rodríguez, we created 16 tranquil and melodic tracks that present a very cosmic and puzzling idea to players of what could have been the very, very beginning of life. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2503140/The_Lullaby_of_Life_Soundtrack/

Thank you so much for your support of The Lullaby of Life. Your support means the world to us as creators!

Paco & the 1 Simple Game team

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.7.0
notes.notes:
Hello Ohmies! 

The team has been hard at work the last few months working on squashing some bug. Today’s patch addresses the following:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the portal for obtaining Bombo's 3rd note disappears after the player character fails to interact with it.
[*] Fixed an issue where a pallet could get stuck behind a locked gate, which would prevent player progression.
[*] Resolved a Main Menu bug where the option highlighter fails to navigate after moving the left joystick of the controller.
[*] Prevented an issue where the player can push all five Ohmies into the non-playable area, preventing the player's progression in level 7, 'Life'.
[*] Fixed an issue where Ohmies may fail to follow the Bombo and stay behind, leading the game to non-progression.
[*] Fixed a specific issue where Bombo can get stuck behind an interactable door, if the player opens the door, moves the Bombo inside, and closes the door before Ohmie enters inside, leading the game to non-progression in level 7, 'Life'.
[*] Solved an issue where Ohmie could fail to detect collision with the obstacle wall and was able to access the switch, leading the game to non-progression.
[*] Remedied a UI issue where the notification fails to appear after collecting the second secret Ohmie of 'Level 5. [/list]
That’s all for this update - if there is anything you would like us to know about let us know in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2493180/discussions/]Steam Discussions tab[/url] or in the [url=https://discord.gg/bMQMkzCtBG]Midwest Games Discord[/url].

- 1 Simple Game and Midwest Games Team

notes.title: The Lullaby of Life available NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

We are beyond excited to officially launch The Lullaby of Life here on Steam today! The game will be 34% off for launch, and you should be able to see the discounted price in your region's currency below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2493180/The_Lullaby_of_Life/

The Lullaby of Life is a puzzle adventure where you encounter puzzles solved through timing-based music notes. Solve these challenges using sound waves matched in sequences of different colors and symbols. Challenge the way you think with each level featuring unique puzzles, mechanics and ambience. notes.title: The Lullaby of Life Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
[i]Play The Lullaby of Life Demo now on Steam! [/i]

Watch the new The Lullaby of Life Trailer now:
[previewyoutube=wbmfUg-OvrM;full][/previewyoutube]

The Lullaby of Life is a tranquil puzzle adventure inspired by the origins of the universe. Explore colorful environments, create harmonious sounds to awaken new beings in this mesmerizing adventure!

[u][b]SOLVE MUSIC DRIVEN PUZZLES[/b][/u]
The Lullaby of Life is a puzzle adventure where you encounter puzzles solved through timing-based music notes. Solve these challenges using sound waves matched in sequences of different colors and symbols. Challenge the way you think with each level featuring unique puzzles, mechanics and ambience. Awaken new companions, bring life to inert beings, and solve your way in this abstract universe!

[u][b]EXPLORE THE ORIGINS OF THE UNIVERSE[/b][/u]
You are the catalyst of new life everywhere in this curious universe. Explore, avoid obstacles, uncover secrets, escape enemies and dangers, and behold this journey where each level brings its own unique setting, characters, and aesthetics.

[u][b]BRING LIFE TO DORMANT BEINGS[/b][/u]
While venturing into this universe you will encounter different beings. The main quest of each level is to awaken your Dormant Elders. Bring them to life through sequences of sound waves produced by you and your found companions picked up along the way.

[u][b]IMMERSE YOURSELF IN A HYPNOTIC WORLD[/b][/u]
The Lullaby of Life presents a vivid and melodious universe like no other. Let the tranquility of the colors, animation and sound waves calm your body while your mind focuses on solving puzzles of increasing difficulties. An immersive game that leaves you feeling peaceful and attuned!

After you complete the demo feel free to Wishlist The Lullaby of Life and stay up to date on release date, developer updates, and more!
